# F₃-index of knots

Computed with all tree diagrams with n <= 9: a knot that is not listed has F₃-index > 9 (or is the unknot, index 1).
Knots up to mirror image, KnotInfo names. n = number of internal vertices of each ternary tree + 1. The representative is an element of F₃ realizing the knot: normal form in the generators y_0, y_1, ... of F₃ (y_{2m} = iota(x_m), see make_table.py) and ternary tree diagram (leaf addresses, 0 = left, 1 = middle, 2 = right).
